title: feat(nssfrm): nssame formdraw n(C) != n(D); unique f(n) leftover does not transfer
science: Introduces the nssame seed class - {0,(0,1,0)} both locking the SAME letter +e_1 - and reports its kernels n(A)=(-1/3,-1/3,0), n(B)=n(C)=(-1/3,0,0), n(D)=(-1/3,1/3,0), so n(C) != n(D) whereas the mixed-lock seed has n(C)=n(D). Carries a genuine group-theoretic control: it enumerates all 24 proper cubic rotations and verifies the same-lock seed is outside the orbit of the mixed-lock seed.
